milestone: 3b: the people and the hour survive a save

tasks.goal: Put the people and the clock's hour, day and rate into the save in src/sim/save.js, and have src/main.js save its people and continue with the restored ones.
tasks.commit: feat(save): the people and the hour survive a save
tasks.notes: SAVE_VERSION becomes 2. serialize adds people: { list: a copy of each person { id, name, age, home, job }, nextId, rand: people.rand.dump() }. isSnapshot also requires s.people to be a plain object. In rebuild, people = createPeople(saved.seed) with the saved list, nextId and rand.load(saved rand) laid over it; reject (throw inside deserialize, so it returns null) a list that is not an array, a person whose id or age is not an integer, whose name is not a string, whose home is not an integer parcel index (0 to city.parcels.length - 1), or whose job is neither null nor such an index, and a nextId that is not an integer. applyClock also restores hour, day and rate with num(). In src/main.js: const people = restored?.people ?? createPeople(SEED), and pass people in the object given to serialize. tests/save.spec.js must stay green.
